webAI is hiring a senior Software Engineer specializing in CRDTs — roughly 5–10+ years of systems experience, with CRDT work a hard requirement — on a remote basis. The role builds the synchronization and networking layer for the company's private, distributed edge AI platform, covering data sync frameworks over content-addressable storage and Merkle trees, plus peer-to-peer and decentralized networking across edge devices, resource-constrained links, and air-gapped or cloud-isolated deployments. Development is in Rust, with the broader stack spanning C++, Go, and cloud infrastructure, alongside security-focused work on key management and cryptographic protocols.
